subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should same-account Telegram ACP binds in one topic preserve multiple session bindings, or is replacing the existing binding an intentional same-account handoff?
rationale: The PR title and body promise independent multi-agent sessions, but the implementation and test assert last-writer-wins, so the permanent binding model needs maintainer intent before repair can be considered merge-ready.

options.title: Require independent bindings
options.body: Keep the PR direction only if the implementation preserves multiple same-account session bindings and routing can select the intended session without overwriting state.

options.title: Treat same-account bind as handoff
options.body: Accept last-writer-wins only after the PR title, tests, docs/proof, and user-facing behavior describe an explicit same-account ownership switch.

options.title: Keep one binding per topic
options.body: Leave current one-topic-one-owner behavior in place and close or redirect this branch if multi-binding routing is not desired now.

recommendation.title: Require independent bindings
recommendation.body: Keep the PR direction only if the implementation preserves multiple same-account session bindings and routing can select the intended session without overwriting state.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current plugin-state storage migration history that constrains the safe binding model change.
